text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper explicitly implements a participatory, spatially explicit LULC prediction framework for the entire mainland of Tanzania (national-scale). Its primary research objective is to develop and compare quantitative LULC projections for two distinct future scenarios (Business as Usual and Green Economy) to 2025. The methodology includes a composite indicator modeling approach that generates national-scale maps of LULC change likelihood and allocates quantified land demand to produce spatially explicit projections. Quantitative metrics of LULC change (area in km², percentages) are reported for each scenario, and the paper evaluates the framework's ability to support national-level planning and policy.)
